Q: How can I enumerate an enum? A:

Here is how I approach it: First things first, enums are simply numbers; so instead of overcomplicating things, use an array of numbers, or a string or dictionaries or something you prefer most. This way is far faster and more efficient than enums, too.

Q: Improving approach on GCD A:

Let us create two arrays arr and brr of size N. Where arr[i] will store the gcd of all the numbers in the input array up to the index i (including i) and brr[i] will store the gcd of all the numbers in the input array after index i including i.

Example: arr[3]=gcd(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3]) and similarly brr will be initialized from opposite direction.

Now suppose the query is 3,5 you can simply output gcd(arr[3],brr[5]).

Q: 0x800f0954 error: Installation of one or more roles, role services, or features failed A:

I have come across the same error when installing OpenSSH Capability on Windows Server 2022. There are a couple of solutions suggested in Microsoft community for this:

  1. Navigate to HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU key and set the UseWUServer DWORD value to 0.

Or

  1. Enabling download repair content and optional features directly from Windows Update using Local Group Policy Editor.

For a detailed explanation please refer to the following link:

https://www.winhelponline.com/blog/error-0x800f0954-net-framework-3-5-optional-feature-dism/

Q: Stack Overflow C++ A:

If you're doing safety critical work you sit down and do the math to ensure you never even come close to running out of stack, and then you test the <expletive deleted> out of the system to make sure you are right. You allow minimal or no variation--recursion, for example, will only be allowed if the maximum depth is known and tolerable--to allow you to compute the worst case consumption, and then you over provision.

Q: Having a a large heading in coloumn headings using GWT A:

FlexTable support setWidget as well as setHTML. You can use either of these for your headers.

Q: How to implement ClickHandler event on a row of a FlexTable A:

If you added userRowCheck to the FlexTable : myFlexTable.addClickHandler(userRowCheck); it should work. Just make sure you test src for null, because if you didn't put a widget in a cell and the user clicks on that cell it returns null.
